english.note: Use 興奮感 as the all-purpose noun for the intense happy excitement or exhilaration itself.
This is the all-purpose choice for a rush or feeling of excitement, including the effect of coffee.

examples.english: Watching the fireworks explode overhead gives me an indescribable exhilaration.
examples.traditional: 睇住煙花喺頭頂爆開，真係有種難以形容嘅興奮感。

examples.english: After finishing the coffee, I had a buzz.
